title: The Ashen Heart
summary: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae travel to the volcanic depths beneath Bukhansan mountain. Navigating boiling sulfur vents and magma lakes, Ha-Jun discovers the third basic relic: The Ashen Heart.

panels.shot: bukhansan mountain at morning wide shot
panels.action: The jagged granite peaks of Bukhansan National Park shrouded in mysterious crimson morning mist.
Behind a roaring frozen waterfall, an ancient cavern mouth glows with unnatural volcanic orange heat.
Min-Jae holds a specialized mana-radiation detector; the needle pegs into the red zone.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Is cave ke niche magma ka flow normal nahi hai... Yeh pure Demonic Hellfire source hai!

panels.action: Ha-Jun tightens his tactical gloves, his white bone gauntlet concealed under a dark thermal sleeve.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum yahan entrance par hi ruko, Min-Jae. Niche ka temperature insaan ke liye fatal hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae hands over an aerosol cryo-canister: 'Ise emergency mein use karna.'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Sambhal kar, Ha-Jun. Bhai ke baad tum hi mere sabse acche dost ho.

panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles with quiet gratitude: 'Main zinda wapas aaunga, promise.'
Ha-Jun descends down a steep obsidian ramp; walls of glowing red magma veins illuminate the dark.
Kuro glides effortlessly through the thermal updrafts, obsidian feathers shimmering with purple embers.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Aah... Yeh garmi mujhe home realm ki yaad dilati hai!

panels.action: A vast underground cavern opens up: a boiling lake of bubbling crimson-orange magma stretching 300 meters across.

panels.shot: steep stone pillars sticking out of lava
panels.action: Jagged black basalt stepping stones rise out of the boiling lava, forming a precarious path to the center.
Ha-Jun stands on the basalt ledge; the ambient air is over 60 degrees Celsius, air shimmering with heat mirages.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Har saans lene par gale mein aag lag rahi hai... Lekin mujhe aage badhna hoga.

panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps from pillar to pillar with nimble athletic balance, lava bubbling mere feet below.

panels.shot: magma salamander fiend erupting from lava
panels.action: A 10-foot armored Magma Salamander with molten rock scales erupts from the boiling lake, snapping jaws.

panels.shot: salamander spitting jet of liquid flame
panels.action: The beast spews a torrent of 1,000-degree liquid hellfire straight toward Ha-Jun's landing spot.
Ha-Jun raises his left arm; the white bone gauntlet interlocks, forming a solid shield that deflects the molten spray.
Kuro cackles: 'Dekha?! Bone of the Forgotten molten rock ko bhi block karti hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ab ise khatam karo! Sanguine Fang!

panels.action: Ha-Jun draws his blood katana; the intense heat causes the crimson blade to hiss with boiling steam.

panels.shot: ha-jun launching off pillar at salamander
panels.action: Ha-Jun vaults forward, slicing cleanly through the beast's armored neck in a diagonal aerial stroke.
The headless salamander splashes back into the boiling magma, dissolving into liquid rock.

panels.shot: ha-jun landing on central obsidian altar
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands firmly on a circular black volcanic glass platform in the dead center of the lake.

panels.shot: the ashen heart suspended in midair
panels.action: Floating above an obsidian basin: a charred, petrified volcanic heart the size of a human skull, beating with violet flame.
From the cracks in the volcanic heart, wisps of violet-and-crimson demonic flame hiss into the sulfurous air.
Kuro's eyes burn with solemn reverence: 'The Ashen Heart. First Sovereign ke wrath ka pyre.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yeh relic tumhare andar Hellfire control ko unleash karega.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring at beating flame heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun can hear the rhythmic thumping of the heart synchronizing with his own chest.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Meri heartbeat... iske saath align ho rahi hai.

panels.action: Kuro warns him strictly: 'Agar tumhara will kamzor pada, toh yeh aag tumhare organs ko raakh bana degi.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ise absorb karne ke liye tumhe apne dono relics ko synchronize karna hoga!

panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his left bone gauntlet and his right ringed hand, forming a dual-relic containment field.
A double-helix of violet mana and crimson blood spirals out from his palms, wrapping around the burning heart.

panels.shot: the ashen heart vibrating with violent fury
panels.action: The charred heart shrieks like an awakening furnace, unleashing a deafening blast of violet hellfire.

panels.shot: flames engulfing ha-jun in a pillar of fire
panels.action: A 50-foot tornado of violet-crimson hellfire erupts skyward, completely swallowing Ha-Jun's silhouette.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes burning through the firestorm
panels.action: Inside the raging inferno, Ha-Jun's eyes ignite with blinding white-violet power as he refuses to yield.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN TUJHE CONTROL KAR KE RAHUNGA... ASHEN HEART!!
